reports.basis.booking_help: Booking date: each reservation counts once, in full, on the day it was booked — all its nights and its whole value, whenever the stay takes place.
reports.basis.stay_help: Stay date: only the nights that fall inside the period count, and revenue is prorated by those nights. Example: a 4-night stay with 2 nights inside the period counts 2 room nights and half its value.

reports.pace.help: Each bar shows how many room nights for stays in the window were already booked on that date. The growth from one bar to the next is the pick-up. Cancelled reservations drop out from the day they were cancelled.
